title: TAP and Klarna's partnership takes off: flexible payments now available in the US, Spain, France and Italy | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**New York, October 13, 2026** - Klarna, the everyday finance network, has expanded its partnership with TAP Air Portugal to the United States, Spain, France and Italy, enabling travellers there to book flights with more flexibility than ever before. From today, customers purchasing tickets on


[flytap.com](http://flytap.com/)


can choose to Pay in Full for a seamless one-time payment experience, Pay in 4, splitting the cost of their booking into four equal, interest-free installments, or for longer stays and family trips, spread the cost over time with Klarna's Financing option.


Whether planning an extended getaway to New York, a beach escape to Miami, or a business trip to Chicago, TAP customers in the United States can now access Klarna’s flexible and transparent payment options at checkout, giving them more control over how and when they pay.


“As one of Europe’s leading airlines, TAP connects travelers to the world, and Klarna is here to connect them to a more convenient way to pay. Whether you’re flying to Miami for a family vacation or New York for work, you can now choose Klarna at checkout to pay in full, split your purchase into four interest-free installments, or spread the cost of a bigger trip over time with financing. Because booking flights should be as smooth as the journey itself.” said


**Lisa Robinson, Head of Partner Success, US East Coast and Canada at Klarna.**


"


*After the success of the launch of Klarna's flexible payments in Portugal, we're delighted to extend this partnership to our customers in the United States, Spain, France and Italy. Offering flexible, interest-free payment options reinforces TAP's commitment to a more accessible and customer-centric travel experience. As we continue to innovate across our network, partnerships like this one with Klarna allow us to give travellers greater control over how they manage their travel budgets.* ", added


**João Frias, Head of Payment Strategy & Fraud Prevention at TAP.**


Klarna's flexible payment options provide an ideal way to manage travel budgets. Spanning over 85 destinations across Europe, the Americas, and Africa, TAP's global network combined with Klarna's commitment to seamless, interest-free payments delivers a smoother, more accessible travel experience, just in time for winter escapes and year-end get-togethers.


**About Klarna**


*Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit*[Klarna.com](https://www.klarna.com/)


*.*


**About TAP Air Portugal**


*TAP is Portugal’ s leading airline and a member of Star Alliance since 2005. Flying since 1945, TAP Air Portugal has its hub in Lisbon, a privileged access platform in Europe, at the crossroads with Africa, North, Central, and South America.*


*TAP Air Portugal is the world's leading airline between Europe and Brazil. TAP offers more than 1 250 weekly flights to 85 cities, which includes 7 airports in Portugal, 10 in North America, 14 in Central and South America, 12 in Africa and 42 in Europe (in addition to Portugal).*


*TAP has made a clear commitment to modernizing its fleet and offering the best product in the sector to its customers. The Portuguese airline operates one of the youngest fleets in the world, with all of Airbus' next generation NEO aircraft: A320neo, A321neo, A321LR, and A330neo, with superior efficiency and reduced emission levels. TAP also operates 19 Embraer aircraft in its regional fleet (TAP Express).*


*TAP is ranked by Airline Ratings in 2025 as the safest airline in Europe and the 11th safest in the world. TAP Air Portugal has been recognized and awarded as Europe's Leading Airline to Africa, as well as Europe's Leading Airline to South America by the World Travel Awards in 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025.*
